notes.title: The first minor update was made.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone (´ω`)ノ

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/2fbad0331446c74054a73f57891c22406969a5b0.jpg[/img]

On August 15th, we released the spicy action game “KOKORONULL”.
We’ve now made a minor update to the game.

The details of the update are as follows:
[list]
[*] Added and updated input instructions for both keyboard and controller.
[*] You can now exit the game with the Select and Start buttons on the controller or the ESC key on the keyboard.
[*] Localization stability improvements.
[*] Various small adjustments.
[/list]

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, but we kindly ask all players to uninstall the game and reinstall it to apply the changes.

----------

With this minor update, the core game system is now complete.
Next, we plan to release a major update, which will include:
[list]
[*] New characters and performances.
[*] Addition of the game’s narrative.
[*] Story progression similar to a visual novel.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/a65354c222c07158d7f3aaa39f381a31bc61dab9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/3d674c4dd2acc7f084d002b2bd596b2c93393640.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047134/1f09021372833aebd05f8cff898e5f9b4f381f13.png[/img]

We appreciate your continued support and look forward to bringing you more exciting content. Thank you for playing!
